questions.question: At Mizpah, what did the men of Israel swear about the tribe of Benjamin?

answers.text: Not one of us will give his daughter to a Benjamite
Not one of us will set foot on Benjamite land
Not one of us will ever trade with a Benjamite

questions.question: When Israel counted who came to the assembly at Mizpah, which town had sent no one?
The young women spared from Jabesh-gilead were enough to give a wife to every surviving Benjamite man. True or false?
Israel's elders told the Benjamites to hide in vineyards near Shiloh to find wives. What were they to watch for?

answers.text: The daughters of Shiloh coming out to dance
The priests of Shiloh coming out to pray
The fathers of Shiloh heading out to the road
